BillHeading.Sponsors: Senators Zeiger, Rolfes, Braun, Rivers, Hunt, Wilson, Keiser, and Angel

BillHistory.ReferredCommittee: Referred to Committee on Law & Justice.

BillHeading.BriefDescription: Eliminating school districts' liability for criminal misconduct of their students that occurs outside of school district custody or supervision.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to school district liability for criminal acts committed by their students; and adding a new section to chapter 28A.320 RCW.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 1. A new section is added to chapter 28A.320 RCW to read as follows:
BillSection.P: School districts are not liable for civil damages resulting from criminal acts committed by any of their students that occur outside of the district's custody or supervision.
